description:
I'm an enthusiastic student from Peshawar, Pakistan, who loves exploring, learning, and sharing knowledge. I'm excited to participate in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 and collaborate with creative, curious students.

I'm looking for teammates preferably (14-15 years girl) interested in space science, technology, design, and storytelling. No expertise required—just curiosity, teamwork, and a willingness to learn!

Learn more: https://alizahayat.online/
